The relations below are constructed and checked in an actual toy elliptic group; they do not measure relation-search cost.
Input Q=(560, 245). The factor base has two unknown logs. All three rows are valid group identities.
A nonzero target-column pairing turns a factor-base dependency into the logarithm.
Toggle the target column in the viewer. Keeping three valid rows does not guarantee that their target coefficients carry information.
